2025 data skims, rerun of skims_2025_data_20261009 with the empty-input-file integrity fix (e375871) and plain-yaml registries (dc788e68); the 9 eras completed by the 20261009 roast are carried over

### Results

1.866 B NanoAOD events processed, 101.85 M saved to picoAOD, from ParkingHH0 + ParkingHH1, eras B-G. Golden JSON `Cert_Collisions2025_391658_398903` (111.19 /fb, online lumi, preliminary); all 513 golden runs are in the skims.

- [new_datasets.yml](https://johnda.web.cern.ch/johnda/HH4b/prod/skims_2025_data_20261010_e375871-c37f3d5/output/skims_2025_data/modified_datasets/new_datasets.yml): only the new picoAOD entries (`datasets: data: '2025': picoAOD: <era>`; 16 eras, 1,026 files). Review this one and merge it into `coffea4bees/metadata/datasets/data.yml`.
- [modified_datasets.yml](https://johnda.web.cern.ch/johnda/HH4b/prod/skims_2025_data_20261010_e375871-c37f3d5/output/skims_2025_data/modified_datasets/modified_datasets.yml): the full datasets metadata with those entries added, the input for later phases.

*Hot patch (2026-10-11):* the roast's original `modified_datasets.yml` held none of the skims. `merge_yaml_datasets.py` parsed `data_2025B11` as year `2025B11` and silently skipped every data key (all data years were affected). Both files were regenerated in the roast checkout with the fixed tool (barista `ee010d42`, [copy as run](https://johnda.web.cern.ch/johnda/HH4b/prod/skims_2025_data_20261010_e375871-c37f3d5/output/skims_2025_data/modified_datasets/merge_yaml_datasets.py.txt)); `new_datasets.yml` was checked file-for-file against the 16 registries. The rule now writes both (coffea4bees `989dd4a8`).

### Event-count check against DBS

Every skim read every valid event DBS lists for its input dataset (16 of 16 OK). [event_counts.yml](https://johnda.web.cern.ch/johnda/HH4b/prod/skims_2025_data_20261010_e375871-c37f3d5/output/skims_2025_data/checks/event_counts.yml).

*Hot patch:* this check is the new `check_event_counts` rule of `Snakefile_PhaseA_1_skimmer.smk`, added after the roast finished. It was run by hand in the roast checkout with the rule's exact command, using the new `src/tools/check_event_counts.py` ([copy as run](https://johnda.web.cern.ch/johnda/HH4b/prod/skims_2025_data_20261010_e375871-c37f3d5/output/skims_2025_data/checks/check_event_counts.py.txt)); no skim was rerun.

"skim lumis" counts lumi sections holding at least one event of the stream (`lumis_processed` is filled from `events.run`/`luminosityBlock`). DBS also counts lumi sections with no events in the stream, so skim lumis are lower even though no event is missing. For the same reason, a luminosity computed from `lumis_processed` (`compute_lumi_processes.py`) slightly undercounts.
